about: ADHAM: supply the WhatsApp business number here, digits only in international format (country code + number, no +, no spaces, no leading 0), then rebuild. While it is empty the build shows NO WhatsApp link anywhere (no broken wa.me link). When it is set, the build adds a https://wa.me/<number> link to the footer, the homepage and the About page contact section. Also update the 'by email' wording (about.contact.p, faq.18a1, terms.who.p) in both languages at the same time.
hours_about: Business hours shown on the homepage and the About page, one line per country in that country's local time. Copied on 2026-10-16 from the local business hours and weekends already set for Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt in the Launchpad sender (crm/launchpad_crm/sender/config.py: Gulf weekend Friday-Saturday, UAE Saturday-Sunday, Egypt Friday). ADHAM: confirm or change them. days: sun-thu, mon-fri or sat-thu; open/close: HH:MM, 24-hour. Remove a country, or empty the object, to hide its line.
